searchText: Given https://twitter.com/anomalroil/status/1558269374691250176, is timelock encryption now finally practical? I though it was only theoretical so this feels like a big deal, but I could definitely be missing something as I’m not an expert here (e.g. maybe the threshold assumption makes it less exciting?) It’s definitely a cool (and surprisingly simple and practical) construction but as you write it suffers from a threshold assumption.
